answer_1.quote: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has been a cornerstone in text generation, leading to the evolution of Code Large Language Models (Code LLMs) which have notably advanced code generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We focused on the pass@1 performance under greedy generation settings across five benchmarks: four Python benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, HumanEval+, MBPP+) and the multi-language benchmark MultiPL-E.
